title: BI Developer
description:

1. Design, automate and support sophisticated data extraction, transformation, and loading applications.

title: Sr. NET Developer
description:
Minimum Qualifications:

 The proposed candidate must have 5 years of experience building complex .NET web applications, API services, functions, workflow, and SQL.
 Experience in the following area(s) is required:
1. 5 years of ASP.NET/MVC
2. 5 years of C# Programming
3. 5 years of REST/SOAP API and web services design
4. 3 years of modern/mobile responsive front-end development using JavaScript, JQuery, Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS3
5. 3 years of Angular
6. 3 years of Entity Framework and SQL Server 2012 or higher database
7. 5 years of .NET Core
8. Copilot or any AI tool for development
 Proposed candidate must have a BS/BA degree in computer science, information technology, or related field. Additional qualifying experience may be substituted for the required degree on a year-for-year basis

SCOPE OF SERVICES
The District seeks resource(s) that will perform the required work closely with LAUSD project team members and perform below responsibilities:
1) Effectively complete applications development by coordinating requirements, schedules and activities; troubleshooting development and production support issues across multiple environments and platforms;
2) Lead the system design and development methodologies and toolset to deliver a modernized web-based system application;
3) Perform unit, integration, and load testing of complex websites, systems integration and applications interfaces;
4) Lead role in the design and implementation of databases architecture, as well as expert management of data loads and data quality assurance;
5) Gather customer software requirements and proposed best software solution and technologies to address business needs;
6) Lead role in establishing and implementing consistent standards, practices, and procedures that will facilitate a high-quality application delivery to district users;
7) Effectively work with project management, leadership and business users to provide time estimates, schedules for projects and any change revisions, communicating regularly with department management and functional users on project requirements, activities and status;
8) Participate in application design strategy and team code review meetings;
9) Provide mentoring as lead to other team members as needed;
10) Ensure knowledge transfer and documentation of all facets of the system application for team members and develop user guide and assistance tools to end users.

title: Data Conversion Lead – SAP to Oracle Cloud (Project‑Management Focus)
description:
Overview

We are seeking a highly capable Data Conversion Lead to manage and coordinate all data migration activities as we transition from SAP to Oracle Cloud. This role is primarily project‐management‐driven, responsible for orchestrating dozens of individual conversion objects across multiple business areas. The Data Conversion Lead will partner closely with Customer functional leads, product owners, and the implementation partner to ensure each conversion is planned, executed, validated, and delivered on schedule.

This position replaces an existing resource and requires someone who can immediately bring structure, discipline, and strong communication to a complex, multi‐threaded workstream. Once conversion cycles are complete, this role will transition into cutover leadership, coordinating the end‐to‐end cutover plan.



Key Responsibilities

Serve as the lead for all data conversion activities across the SAP‐to‐Oracle migration.
Partners with Customer functional leads and product owners to ensure each conversion object has clear requirements, mapping, ownership, and acceptance criteria.
Coordinate planning, scheduling, and execution of multiple conversion cycles (mock loads, dry runs, dress rehearsals).
Track progress, dependencies, risks, and issues across dozens of conversion objects.
Facilitate cross‐functional working sessions to resolve mapping questions, data quality issues, and validation gaps.
Oversee extraction, cleansing, transformation, and load activities performed by technical teams and the implementation partner.
Drive reconciliation and validation efforts with business SMEs to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
Maintain detailed conversion plans, dashboards, and status reporting for program leadership.
Lead cutover planning and execution, including load sequencing, checkpoints, and go/no‐go readiness.
Communicate clearly and consistently with business stakeholders, technical teams, and leadership.


Required Skills & Experience

Ideally this candidate has strong experience managing conversions in either SAP or Oracle.
Demonstrated success managing complex, multi‐object conversion portfolios.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence and drive accountability.
Strong project management discipline: planning, RAID management, dependency tracking, and stakeholder coordination.
Experience working with system integrators and cross‐functional business teams.
Ability to quickly stabilize a challenged workstream and implement structure.


Preferred Qualifications

Experience migrating from SAP ECC or S/4HANA to Oracle Cloud.
Familiarity with data governance, data quality frameworks, and reconciliation processes.
Prior experience leading cutover for a large ERP implementation.

title: General Ledger BSA Consultant – SAP to Oracle Cloud
description:
Minimum Qualifications:

Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled General Ledger Business Systems Analyst (BSA) to support the Finance workstream during our SAP‐to‐Oracle Cloud migration. This role will focus on requirements gathering, data validation, sprint participation, testing, and close collaboration with our implementation partner . This position replaces an existing resource and requires someone who can immediately bring structure, clarity, and strong communication to a fast‐moving program.

Primary Skill: General Ledger Business Systems Analyst (BSA) to support the Finance workstream during SAP‐to‐Oracle Cloud migration.


Key Responsibilities
  • Serve as the primary BSA for the General Ledger workstream during the Oracle Cloud implementation.
  • Collect, refine, and validate business and functional requirements.
  • Validate data migration results for GL, COA, balances, journals, and related financial objects.
  • Partner with the implementation partner to ensure configuration aligns with business needs.
  • Support testing cycles (SIT, UAT) by developing test scenarios, validating results, and documenting defects.
  • Provide clear, concise communication with business stakeholders and project leadership.
  • Track issues, dependencies, and risks with strong project management discipline.
  • Support cutover readiness activities related to GL data and financial close processes.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong understanding of Oracle Cloud Financials (GL) .
  • Hands‐on experience with data validation, reconciliation, and financial reporting.
  • Excellent communication skills—able to work effectively with finance users and technical teams.
  • Strong analytical and documentation skills, including requirements, process flows, and test scripts.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project environments (optional).
  • Ability to step into a challenged workstream and quickly bring structure and clarity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience migrating from SAP to Oracle Cloud, or other large-scale migration/implementation projects.
  • Familiarity with COA redesign, financial close processes, and cross‐module dependencies.
  • Background in large, complex transformation programs.
